newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines Q3 outlook "quite good".
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines Q3 outlook "quite good".

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said Thursday that its current outlook for the third quarter is "quite good.

Chairman, President and Chief Executive Herbert Kelleher said in a statement that the company is hoping for a continuation of lower jet fuel prices; "excellent results from our cost reduction initiatives; and strong yields, despite the reimposition of the ticket tax."
The airline also said it hopes that a promotion for this fall will stimulate traffic and revenue in the period between September and December.
In the second quarter ended June 30, the company posted net income of $93.83 million, or $0.62 per share, on operating revenues of $956.89 million.
In the same period in the prior year, the company reported net income of $85.32 million, or $0.56 per share, on operating revenues of $910.31 million.
